title: Things to Do in Longmont | Loving Longmont
text:
Explore Our Community What Should We Do Today? Longmont offers everything from peaceful lakes and mountain-view
          trails to historic farms, family adventures, arts, recreation and
          experiences for people looking for something completely different.
          Start exploring below. Outdoor adventures Nature, farms & recreation → Arts & creativity Art spaces, music & classes → Family activities Search family-friendly places → Longmont history Explore historic places → Farms & seasonal experiences Discover local farms → All local businesses Browse the directory → The Loving Longmont Guide Explore Longmont From free outdoor adventures to memorable experiences, there is a lot
          more to do around Longmont than you may realize. $$ PAID Pottery • Glass • Creative Fun Crackpots A downtown paint-your-own-pottery studio offering glass fusing,
              mosaics, classes, parties and walk-in creative time for all ages. 📍 Address: 505 Main Street, Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-776-2211 🎨 Good to Know: Walk-ins are welcome; check
                the calendar for classes and events. Official Website Choose Your Adventure What Kind of Day Are You Looking For? 💚 A Completely Free Day Walk around McIntosh Lake, explore Golden Ponds, visit the
            Agricultural Heritage Center or discover Longmont history at
            Sandstone Ranch. 👨‍👩‍👧 A Family Day Explore Dickens Farm, meet the animals at Sunflower Farm or spend
            the afternoon swimming at the Longmont Recreation Center. ❤️ A Date Day Take a sunset walk at Golden Ponds or McIntosh Lake, try climbing
            together or ice skate during the winter. 🌊 A Water Day Kayak or paddleboard at McIntosh Lake or spend a full summer day at
            Union Reservoir. 🌧️ A Rainy Day Try the Longmont Climbing Collective, Recreation Center or check the
            Longmont Museum's program schedule. 🪂 A Bucket-List Day Go skydiving over the Front Range or try something new like
            climbing, kayaking or paddleboarding. Before You Go Hours, prices, programs and seasonal availability can change. Use
            the official website button on each listing before making a special
            trip. Most Longmont nature areas are open approximately one hour before
            sunrise until one hour after sunset. A Colorado Parks & Wildlife fishing license is required at Longmont
            fishing locations when applicable. Water levels and creek conditions vary throughout the year. Always
            follow posted safety information. Many outdoor Longmont attractions are completely free, making it
            possible to explore the community without spending anything. Help Build the Guide Know Something We Should Add? Have a favorite Longmont park, attraction, activity, hidden gem or
        experience that belongs on this page? Tell us about it. Suggest Something →

Jobs • Careers • Extra Income Looking for Work? Start Here. Whether you're searching for a full-time career,
need work quickly, want help improving your résumé,

way to earn some extra money, these Longmont and Colorado
resources can help you get started. 🔎 I Need a Job Search local and national job boards. ⚡ I Need Work Quickly Connect with Longmont staffing and temp agencies. 📝 I Need Résumé Help Find free résumé, interview and career assistance. 💵 I Want a Side Gig Explore flexible ways to earn extra income. 🎓 I Want Better Skills Find training, workshops and career-development resources. 🏠 I Want Remote Work Search job sites that include work-from-home opportunities. 🤝 Start Here — Free Local Help Workforce Boulder County Workforce Boulder County is one of the most useful

Become a Tasker → 💻 Upwork Freelance online projects including admin, writing,
design, marketing and technical work. Visit Upwork → 📦 Amazon Flex Deliver Amazon packages using your own vehicle
where local openings are available. Check Availability → Build Your Next Career Training & Career Development Sometimes the fastest path to better pay is gaining one
new skill or certification. These resources can help you
explore that path. 💻 Free Computer Training Workforce Boulder County Computer Training Workforce Boulder County provides self-guided computer
training that can build workplace skills and add
certificates of completion to your résumé. Computer Training 🛠️ Earn While You Learn Registered Apprenticeships Apprenticeships combine paid on-the-job experience
with structured training. Options exist in trades,
technology, healthcare and other industries. Search Apprenticeships 📚 Free Library Learning Longmont Library Learning Resources Use your library card for learning, test preparation,
career resources, résumé assistance and other educational
tools that can help you move into a new role. Explore Library Learning Job Search Safety Unfortunately, job seekers are common targets for scams.
A few precautions can help protect you. Be cautious if a company offers you a job without a real
interview or meaningful conversation. Never pay an employer for the privilege of getting a job. Do not purchase gift cards, cryptocurrency or equipment
for a supposed employer and expect reimbursement later. Verify that the employer's email address matches its
official company website whenever possible. Be suspicious of unusually high pay for very simple
work, especially unsolicited remote-job offers. Never give banking, Social Security or identity information
until you have verified the employer and reached the
legitimate hiring/onboarding stage. When in doubt, find the company's official website yourself
instead of clicking the link in a suspicious message. Know a Helpful Resource? Help Us Make This Guide Better If you know of a legitimate Longmont employment resource,
staffing agency, training program or organization that
helps local residents find work, let Loving Longmont know. Suggest a Resource →

title: Business Listing Pricing | Loving Longmont
text: For Longmont Businesses Your business belongs here. Help local customers get to know your business. Keep your basic listing free, or add a richer business page and more ways to connect. A place in the community Free Listing $0 No annual charge Business name and short description Address or service area and phone, when available Official website link, if you have one Existing directory image, when available Free ownership claim and basic information corrections Claim my listing → More room to tell your story Enhanced Listing $149 For 12 months · paid annually Everything in the Free Listing A dedicated business page with its own shareable URL Expanded description, services and business hours Up to four social media links A gallery of up to five business-supplied photos A booking, menu or shopping link Four owner-requested content updates per year Request Enhanced → Your business in the spotlight Featured Listing $299 For 12 months · paid annually Everything in the Enhanced Listing Photo gallery expanded to up to ten photos Clearly labeled featured placement above free listings in your relevant directory category One business introduction on Loving Longmont's Facebook page per year Two additional promotional Facebook page posts per year Four owner-requested content updates per year Request Featured → Founding business offer Enhanced for $99 for your first year The first 20 paid Enhanced Listing customers receive their first 12 months for $99. Renewal is $149 per year. Contact us to confirm availability before purchasing. Ask about the founding offer → Simple plans. Clear expectations. How do I get started? Choose a plan and send your business name and contact details using the request button. We will confirm your listing, collect your content and arrange payment before publishing paid features. Your request does not charge your card or enroll you automatically. What if I do not have a website? Your free listing can show your address or service area and phone. An Enhanced or Featured Listing gives you a dedicated Loving Longmont page to share your services, hours, photos and contact information. Is claiming my business free? Yes. Confirming ownership and correcting basic business information are free. Paid plans add the features listed above. Please use a business email or provide information that helps us verify your connection to the business. How do annual plans work? Paid features run for 12 months from activation. There is no monthly charge and no automatic renewal at this stage. We will contact you before renewal; if you do not renew, your listing returns to the free format. What counts as a content update? One consolidated request to change your description, services, hours, links or photos counts as one update. Basic factual corrections remain free. You supply photos you have permission to use. Promotional post timing and featured placement are arranged with our team; featured placement may be shared with other featured businesses. What results can I expect? Your plan purchases the presentation and promotion described here. Customer inquiries, sales and search rankings are not guaranteed. Paid features are labeled clearly. title: About Loving Longmont | Loving Longmont
text: People • Places • Possibilities Why Loving Longmont A community resource created to help Longmont residents discover, connect with and support the local businesses, people, events and places that make our community unique. Michelle Skolyak, Tim Skolyak & Kayli Elliott — the family behind MKT Visibility Our Story Why Loving Longmont Loving Longmont began in 2021 , not long after I moved to Longmont. I was new to the community, and I created Loving Longmont because I wanted a place to discover and share the things that make Longmont such a great place to live. In September 2026, an unexpected corporate layoff changed my direction. It gave me the desire to take what I had learned throughout my working years and use that experience to help small businesses. Owning a business and working for myself had also been a dream of mine for a long time. Instead of simply moving on to another corporate position, I partnered with my son Tim Skolyak and Kayli Elliott to start MKT Visibility , a family-owned marketing business focused on helping small businesses get noticed, connect with customers and grow. Community + Local Business Why These Two Projects Belong Together The world can feel pretty complicated sometimes, but one thing we can influence is what happens right here in our own community. I believe communities are stronger when local businesses thrive, neighbors support one another, and residents get out and experience the place they call home. That's where Loving Longmont and MKT Visibility work together. Loving Longmont Loving Longmont is for the community. It's a place to discover local businesses, restaurants, events, activities, jobs, nonprofits, animals, history, outdoor spaces, and the people and stories that make Longmont unique. MKT Visibility MKT Visibility is for the businesses behind the community. We help small businesses become easier to find and give owners support with marketing, websites, social media, content, photography, and their online presence. For residents, we hope you'll use this site to discover more of Longmont and support the people and businesses around you. For business owners, we hope Loving Longmont gives you another place to be discovered —and if you want to see how your business appears to potential customers online, MKT Visibility offers a free Business Visibility Check. Get a Free Business Visibility Check → Be Part of Loving Longmont Help Us Build It Tell us about your favorite local business. Send us an event. Share a hidden gem. Nominate someone for In the Spotlight . Let us know about something we're missing. Because a strong Longmont isn't built by one website or one business. It's built by all of us. Share Something With Us → People • Places • Possibilities — Michelle Skolyak Founder, Loving Longmont Co-Founder, MKT Visibility

title: Longmont Community Resources | Loving Longmont
text:
Neighbors • Local Food • Connection • Help Community Starts Close to Home Longmont is full of places where people can
shop directly from local farmers,
find help when times are difficult,
volunteer,
connect with a faith or spiritual community,
practice mindfulness
and simply meet more of the people
who share this city with them.

This guide brings many of those local resources together. 🥕 Markets & Local Food Farmers markets, farm stands and locally grown food. 🌻 Farms & Orchards Local farms you can visit, shop or experience. 🥫 Food & Basic Needs Food banks, free groceries and community assistance. 🕊️ Faith & Spirituality Local congregations and spiritual communities. 🧘 Meditation & Wellness Local meditation, mindfulness and yoga communities. 🤝 Community & Volunteering Give your time, meet neighbors or find local support. 🥕 Longmont Farmers Market Local farmers • ranchers • food makers • artisans A Longmont Saturday Tradition Longmont Farmers Market The Longmont Farmers Market
brings together more than 100
Colorado farmers, ranchers,
food producers and local vendors
at the Boulder County Fairgrounds. It is a growers-only market,
meaning the food is grown,
raised or produced locally
and sold by the people who make it.

Live music, children's activities
and community gathering
are also part of the market experience. 📍 Location: Boulder County Fairgrounds 9595 Nelson Road, Longmont 📅 2026 Season: Saturdays, April 4 – November 21 🕐 Hours: 8 a.m.–1 p.m. 🎨 Artisan Market: Fourth Saturday of the month,
April through October. 🥬 Food Access: SNAP/EBT and eligible food-access programs are supported. Market Information Artisan Markets Grown Close to Home Visit Longmont Farms & Farm Stands These small, family-run farms give you a chance
to buy closer to the source,
meet growers
and experience Longmont's agricultural roots. 🌱 Family Farm • Farm Stand Ollin Farms A family-run regenerative farm
growing vegetables and building community
around food, healthy soil and education.

The farm offers a seasonal farm stand,
CSA shares, youth education,
farm tours and farm-to-table dinners. 📍 Address: 8627 N 95th Street Longmont, CO 80504 🥕 Farm Stand: Weekdays 10 a.m.–6 p.m. Saturdays 10 a.m.–2 p.m. 🍽 Experiences: Farm dinners, education and scheduled farm tours. Visit Farm Website Farm Stand 🥬 Organic Farm • Roadside Stand Aspen Moon Farm A USDA Certified Organic Longmont farm
growing vegetables, herbs, flowers
and starter plants using biodynamic practices.

The seasonal roadside stand makes it easy
to shop directly from the farm. 📍 Farm Stand: 7940 Hygiene Road Longmont, CO 80503 🌱 Also Offers: CSA memberships and seasonal plants. 🥕 Market: Also sells at the Longmont Farmers Market. Visit Farm Website 🍎 Orchard • Farm Stand YA YA Farm & Orchard A small historic orchard specializing
in heirloom apples and family-oriented
farm experiences.

Visitors can shop the farm stand,
see the farm animals,
bring a picnic
and enjoy seasonal events. 📍 Address: 6914 Ute Highway Longmont, CO 80503 🍎 Farm Stand: Seasonal, generally August through fall. 🌸 U-Pick: Reservations are required for apple and pear picking.
2026 U-Pick reservations are currently sold out. 💵 General Admission: No admission fee for regular farm-stand visits. Visit Orchard Website 🐝 Small Family Farm The Bee Hugger Farm A small family-run farm where visitors
can see farm animals,
learn about bees,
feed animals,
explore tractors
and enjoy seasonal flowers and pumpkins. 📍 Address: 12590 Ute Highway Longmont, CO 80504 💵 General Visit: The farm offers free general entry during posted farm hours,
with optional paid experiences. 🐐 Good to Know: Animal feed is available onsite.
Please leave pets at home. Visit Farm Website 🎃 Organic Farm • Seasonal Rocky Mountain Pumpkin Ranch A family-run organic farm
with a seasonal farm stand,
plants, produce
and fall activities.

It is especially popular
during pumpkin season
but also operates a farm market
during the growing season. 📍 Address: 9059 Ute Highway Longmont, CO 80503 🌱 Farm Stand: Seasonal produce, plants and flowers. Visit Website Neighbors Helping Neighbors Food & Basic Needs If you need food,
know someone who does,
or want to donate or volunteer,
Longmont has several community-based organizations ready to help. ❤️ Food • Meals • Family Support OUR Center A Longmont nonprofit resource center
providing groceries, meals
and other support to individuals
and families working toward stability
and self-sufficiency. 📍 Address: 220 Collyer Street Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-772-5529 🥫 Pantry: Weekday food assistance is available. 🍽 Meals: Hot meal programs are also offered. OUR Center 🥕 Free Food • Food Rescue Longmont Food Rescue A local nonprofit reducing food waste
while getting fresh food directly
to people who can use it.

Programs include no-cost groceries,
free produce distributions,
community fridges
and Fresh Food Connect. 🥬 Produce Distributions: Free food distributions are held regularly
with no questions asked. 🧊 Community Fridges: Free community refrigerators
allow neighbors to give or take food. Longmont Food Rescue Distribution Schedule 🥫 Community Food Bank St. John the Baptist Food Bank A volunteer-supported Longmont food bank
providing food boxes to local individuals
and families experiencing difficult times. 📍 Address: 804 S Lincoln Street Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-678-1469 🕐 Current Schedule: Tuesday 10:30 a.m.–6 p.m. Wednesday 10:30 a.m.–5 p.m. Thursday 10:30 a.m.–1 p.m. Food Bank Information 🛒 No-Cost Groceries The ROUND PANTRY A community food distribution
hosted by Westview Presbyterian Church.

Shoppers receive prepacked groceries
including pantry foods
and fresh items when available.

No qualification or ID is required. 📍 Address: 1500 Hover Street Longmont, CO 80501 📅 When: 2nd and 4th Tuesdays 🕐 Hours: 2–6 p.m. 🚶 Access: Drive-up and walk-up options. Round Pantry 🍞 Volunteer-Run Food Pantry Table of Hope Food Pantry A volunteer-run nonprofit food pantry
operating from White Fields Community Church.

The pantry provides food assistance
and welcomes community volunteers
to help with distribution and operations. 📍 Address: 2950 Colorful Avenue #100 Longmont, CO 80504 ☎ Phone: 720-781-7526 🤝 Help: No ID or documentation is required
for pantry assistance. Current Information 🍲 Meals • Seniors • Disability Support Longmont Meals on Wheels A local nonprofit delivering
hot meals and a daily wellness check
to older adults
and people with disabilities
in Longmont and Niwot. 📍 Address: 910 Longs Peak Avenue Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-772-0540 🤝 Volunteers: Meal delivery, kitchen help
and special projects. Meals on Wheels Need Help Today? Longmont Has More Food Assistance Than What's Listed Here The City of Longmont maintains a current community-resource directory
with additional food pantries, transportation assistance,
mental-health resources and other local services. Longmont Community Resources → Faith • Fellowship • Community Local Faith & Spiritual Communities Longmont has many congregations and spiritual communities.
These are a few local places that combine
worship or spiritual practice
with community connection,
service and outreach. 🪷 Buddhist Community Longmont Buddhist Temple A small Jodo Shinshu Buddhist community
welcoming newcomers,
longtime practitioners
and anyone interested in learning more about Buddhism. 📍 Address: 606 Pike Road Longmont, CO 80501 🧘 Meditation: Guided meditation class
on the first Sunday of each month. 📖 Buddhism Class: Third Sunday of each month. 🕊 Services: Second and fourth Sundays. Temple Website ❤️ United Methodist Heart of Longmont A longstanding United Methodist congregation
with worship, study groups,
community events,
service projects
and meditation programming. 📍 Address: 350 11th Avenue Longmont, CO 80501 🕐 Worship: Sunday at 10 a.m. ☎ Phone: 303-776-3523 Church Website ⛪ Presbyterian • Community Outreach Westview Presbyterian Church A Longmont Presbyterian congregation
with worship, study groups,
fellowship activities
and extensive community service
through The ROUND PANTRY. 📍 Address: 1500 Hover Street Longmont, CO 80501 🕐 Worship: Sunday at 9:30 a.m. ☎ Phone: 303-776-3242 Church Website ⛪ Catholic Community St. John the Baptist Catholic Church A longstanding Longmont Catholic parish
with English and Spanish services,
religious education,
community ministries
and its own community food bank. 📍 Address: 323 Collyer Street Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-776-0737 🌎 Languages: English and Spanish services are offered. Parish Website 🤝 Christian Community LifeBridge Christian Church A local Christian congregation
offering Sunday worship,
children's programming,
student ministry
and opportunities to connect
through community groups and service. 📍 Address: 10345 Ute Highway Longmont, CO 80504 🕐 Sunday Services: 8 a.m., 9:30 a.m. and 11 a.m. Church Website Pause • Breathe • Connect Meditation, Mindfulness & Yoga For people looking for community
outside a traditional religious setting,
Longmont also has locally rooted spaces
for meditation, yoga, breathwork
and mindful movement. 🧘 Yoga • Meditation • Community Full Circle Yoga A community-focused downtown yoga studio
offering a variety of practices
including yoga, meditation,
restorative classes
and specialty programming. 📍 Downtown Longmont 🧘 Offerings: Yoga, meditation, restorative practice,
prenatal yoga and community programming. 🌿 Local Yoga & Mindfulness E8YOGA A locally owned Longmont studio
with heated and non-heated yoga,
meditation,
yoga nidra,
sound experiences
and community events. 📍 Address: 1127 Francis Street Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-818-9786 ✨ Mindful Movement SOUL 19 A Longmont mindful-movement studio
combining yoga,
strength,
barre,
breathwork
and meditation.

The studio emphasizes connection,
growth and shared experience. 📍 Address: 1350 Ken Pratt Boulevard Longmont, CO ☎ Phone: 720-600-4868 Studio Website Give Help • Find Help • Meet People Community Resources & Volunteering One of the easiest ways to feel connected to a community
is to participate in it.

These Longmont organizations and public resources
offer ways to volunteer,
learn,
meet people
or receive support. ☕ Recovery • Belonging • Volunteer Recovery Café Longmont A community-centered recovery organization
creating a welcoming space
for people rebuilding their lives.

Volunteer opportunities include cooking,
hospitality,
teaching classes
and helping with support activities. 📍 Address: 402 Kimbark Street Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 720-815-2885 🕐 Regular Hours: Tuesday–Friday, 11 a.m.–7 p.m. Recovery Café Volunteer 🧓 55+ Community Longmont Senior Center A local gathering place for adults 55+
with more than 200 programs each quarter,
including classes,
fitness,
technology help,
social activities,
support services
and volunteer opportunities. 📍 Address: 910 Longs Peak Avenue Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-651-8411 Senior Services 📚 Free Community Resource Longmont Public Library More than books.

The Longmont Library offers
free programs for children, teens and adults,
classes,
digital resources,
community events,
volunteer opportunities
and spaces to learn and connect. 📍 Address: 355 Emery Street Longmont, CO 80501 ☎ Phone: 303-651-8470 Library Volunteer 🙋 Volunteer Longmont Find a Local Volunteer Opportunity Longmont residents can volunteer
with parks,
trails,
the library,
museum,
senior services,
youth programs,
community events,
public safety
and sustainability programs. 🌳 Opportunities Include: Parks and open space,
library programs,
museum events,
recreation,
senior services
and community boards. Volunteer Opportunities 🏡 Older Adult Support Cultivate A nonprofit helping older adults
remain independent and connected
through volunteer-powered services
such as grocery help,
minor home repairs,
yard work,
snow shoveling
and medical rides. ☎ Phone: 303-443-1933 🤝 Participate: Receive services or become a volunteer. Cultivate More Ways to Belong Community Doesn't Have to Be Complicated Sometimes connection starts with something simple:
buying vegetables from a farmer,
volunteering for an afternoon,
joining a class
or introducing yourself to someone new. 🥕 Buy Local Food Shopping from local farms
and growers keeps more money
in the local food system
and creates connections
between residents and the people
who grow their food. 🤝 Volunteer Food pantries,
senior programs,
libraries,
parks
and local nonprofits
all depend on people
willing to give a little time. 👋 Show Up Markets,
classes,
community events,
faith communities
and local groups
are easier places to meet people
than waiting for community to find you. Your Longmont Help Us Find More of the Community Some of the best local resources
are the ones neighbors tell each other about. 💬 Ask Loving Longmont Looking for a local resource,
organization,
group
or recommendation?

Ask us. Ask a Question 💡 Recommend a Resource Know a farm,
food pantry,
church,
local group,
nonprofit
or community resource
that belongs here? Suggest a Resource 📷 Share Longmont Send an original local photograph,
community story
or something positive
you think Longmont should see. Share With Us People • Places • Possibilities Know Something Longmont Should Know? Loving Longmont will keep growing
as neighbors share local places,
resources,
organizations,
photos,
stories
and ideas.

If something helps people connect with Longmont,
we want to know about it. Contact Loving Longmont →

title: Animals & Pets in Longmont | Loving Longmont
text:
Furry • Feathered • Scaly • Wild Longmont Loves Animals Whether you're looking to adopt, help an injured wild animal,
visit a farm, volunteer with a rescue, find a local veterinarian,
buy pet supplies or find someone trustworthy to care for your pets,
start here. ❤️ Help Animals Shelters, rescues, wildlife rehabilitation and volunteering. 🐐 Visit Animals Farms, rescued animals, horses and family experiences. 🩺 Veterinarians Independent and locally focused veterinary practices. 🦴 Pet Supplies Local alternatives to large national pet-store chains. 🐕 Pet Sitting & Boarding Local sitters, dog walkers, kennels and home care. 🚨 Lost or Injured Animal Emergency, wildlife and lost-pet resources. Rescue • Adopt • Volunteer Help Animals & Wildlife Adopt, foster, volunteer, donate or find professional help
for an animal in need. 🦎 Found an Injured Reptile or Amphibian? Greenwood Wildlife Rehabilitation Center does not rehabilitate reptiles or amphibians. For injured or orphaned reptiles and amphibians, contact Colorado Reptile Humane Society (CoRHS) or Rocky Mountain Wildlife Alliance. Colorado Reptile Humane Society Rocky Mountain Wildlife Alliance Meet • Learn • Explore Places to See Animals Longmont has several farms and sanctuaries where families
can meet animals, learn about agriculture and enjoy time outside. 🐄 Rescued Farm Animals Good Life Refuge Kindness Tours Meet rescued pigs, chickens, cows, alpacas, ducks,
goats and other sanctuary residents while learning
their stories during a guided tour. 📍 Address: 13759 N 95th Street, Longmont 🎟 Visits: Scheduled public or private tours. ⏱ Tour Length: Approximately 45 minutes. Book a Kindness Tour 🐎 Horses Visit Colorado Horse Rescue Meet horses cared for by Colorado's longest-standing
horse rescue and learn about rehabilitation, adoption
and responsible equine care. 📍 Address: 10386 N 65th Street, Longmont 👋 Visits: Schedule ahead. Schedule a Visit Local Pet Healthcare Longmont Veterinarians A selection of established, independent or locally focused
veterinary practices serving Longmont pets. Shop Local Independent & Local Pet Supplies Before ordering from a national chain, consider supporting
one of Longmont's smaller pet businesses. When You Can't Be There Pet Sitting, Walking & Boarding Local pet-care options for vacations, workdays,
daily walks and overnight care. Save This Section Lost, Found or Injured Animal? Who you should call depends on whether the animal is a pet,
wildlife or an immediate safety concern. 🐕 Lost or Found Pet Longmont Humane Society 303-772-1232 Lost & Found Pet Resources → 🦝 Injured Wildlife Greenwood Wildlife Rehabilitation Center 303-823-8455 Call before picking up or transporting wildlife whenever possible. 🦎 Reptiles & Amphibians: Colorado Reptile Humane Society (CoRHS) 303-776-2070 CoRHS rehabilitates Colorado-native reptiles and amphibians. 🚓 Animal Control City of Longmont Animal Control 303-651-8500 Animal concerns, injured domestic animals, bites,
at-large animals and certain wildlife situations. 🏔 Large Wildlife Colorado Parks & Wildlife St. Vrain Area Office: 303-485-0186 Appropriate for deer, elk and other larger wildlife situations. More Help for Pet Families Useful Longmont Pet Resources 🥫 Need Pet Food? Longmont Humane Society operates a Public Pet Pantry with
free pet food and other supplies for community members
who need assistance. Pet Pantry 🏷️ License Your Pet Dogs and cats living within Longmont city limits must
be licensed. Pet licensing also helps reunite lost animals
with their families. Licensing Information 💚 Volunteer With Animals Longmont Humane Society, Colorado Horse Rescue,
Good Life Refuge, Greenwood Wildlife and Colorado Reptile
Humane Society all offer ways for volunteers to help. Know Another Great Local Resource? Help Us Build the Animal Guide Know a Longmont animal rescue, independent veterinarian,
pet sitter, farm, wildlife resource or locally owned pet
business that belongs here? Send it to Loving Longmont. Suggest an Animal Resource →

          events and places that make Longmont, Colorado such a special place
          to live, work and visit. 📅 Events Find local events, festivals, markets, live music and community
            happenings. View Events → 🏪 Local Businesses Discover and support the local businesses that make Longmont unique. Find Businesses → 🏔️ Things to Do Explore parks, trails, attractions, recreation and activities for
            all ages. Explore More → 🏛️ History Discover historic homes, pioneer buildings and places that preserve
            Longmont’s story. Explore History → 🌟 In The Spotlight Read Loving Longmont features about local businesses, people,
            places and stories. Read Spotlights → 🐾 Animals & Pets Find shelters, rescues, farms, veterinarians, pet supplies and
            animal resources. Explore Animals & Pets → 💼 Jobs Find local job resources, career help, staffing agencies, side gigs
            and ways to find work. Find Jobs → 👥 Community Ask questions, share recommendations and connect with Longmont
            neighbors. Join the Community → 🗺️ Site Map Browse the complete Loving Longmont directory and find every guide,

          celebrate the people and places that make our city home. Have
          something to share? We'd love to hear from you. Get Involved → Explore Our City Longmont Through Our Lens Original photographs taken around Longmont. Downtown Longmont Parks & Trails Longmont Landmarks & Art Support Local Discover Longmont Businesses From longtime local favorites to new businesses just getting
            started, Loving Longmont is a place to discover the people and
            businesses serving our community. Explore Local Businesses → Be Part of Loving Longmont What's Happening in Longmont? Loving Longmont grows through the people who live here. Help us
          discover what's happening throughout our community. 📅 Submit an Event Have an upcoming festival, fundraiser, market, class or community
              event? Send It to Us → 🏪 Recommend a Business Own a Longmont business or know a local business we should
              discover? Tell Us About It → 📷 Photos & Stories Share a local photograph, story, community accomplishment or idea. Share With Us → ✉️ Stay in the Loop Get the latest events, spotlights and community updates. Subscribe
